historical_baseline.label: original compilable bootstrap
selection_evidence: contains the initial contracts, manifest model, local transport and node-agent crates
precedes the 142280f embedded-runtime removal and all kernel decomposition milestones

pre_major_refactor_checkpoint.label: pre-split core after embedded Python/container removal

migration_map.responsibility: vendor discovery and node bridge moved out of Kernel; Kernel receives generic resource facts
node-local journal, session bridge and self-upgrade remain in the Node Agent
the old stdio data plane was replaced by Plugin-owned direct endpoints; Platform keeps only endpoint lifecycle
generic worker supervision uses the Kernel InstanceActor path; Product requests go directly to Plugin-owned endpoints
process handle and instance state are split between Kernel lifecycle decisions and the sandbox adapter
privileged process/cgroup implementation is Sandbox Adapter; Kernel retains only a generic client and decision port
managed-process lifecycle metadata remains under Kernel daemon supervision
vendor probing is an external adapter; Kernel consumes generic adapter protocol facts
cy-manifest now mirrors only generic Plugin control-plane and Artifact identity contracts; Product AI manifests were removed
versioned Kernel semantic contract is explicit and independently tested
stable Kernel ports and lifecycle domain types are separated without changing authority ownership
daemon authority, protocol conversion, RPC projection, service supervision and recovery are explicit modules
untyped legacy AgentService/AI RPC was replaced by typed, versioned Kernel and capability contracts
the old duplicate supervisor was decommissioned after all proxies moved to InstanceActor

correctness_capabilities.principal: kernel/crates/cy-kernel-daemon/src/peer_cred.rs and authority.rs derive and require authenticated semantic Principal
correctness_capabilities.operation: cy-kernel-api authority operation ports and cy-kernel-daemon operation conversion/RPC lifecycle
correctness_capabilities.resource: cy-resource-manager/src/lib.rs and semantic resource contract; inventory generations are checked before allocation
correctness_capabilities.lease_fence: cy-kernel-api/src/lease.rs, cy-resource-manager fencing, daemon authority lease transitions, and release/revocation tests
correctness_capabilities.capability: framework/crates/cy-platform-api resolves generic capability interfaces; Products call Plugin-owned endpoints directly
correctness_capabilities.endpoint: cy-kernel-api authority endpoint/grant ports and daemon purge_endpoint_authority enforce lease-bound endpoint grants
correctness_capabilities.event: cy-kernel-daemon authority event store/history plus RPC WatchEvents projections
correctness_capabilities.replay_live_handoff: authority snapshot captures cursor before state read; read_events and both v1/v2 WatchEvents use ordered replay then notifier handoff
correctness_capabilities.cleanup_recovery: service_manager, watchdog, sandboxed_process and runtime journal require confirmed physical cleanup; startup recovery tests cover stale processes and epoch-scoped cursors

ownership.Kernel: authenticated authority, leases/fences, lifecycle decisions, generic protocol validation and recovery policy
ownership.Resource Manager: resource inventory, allocation, lease state and cleanup-confirmed release
ownership.Platform API: language-neutral capability and worker activation projections
ownership.Package Runtime: immutable package installation/dependency preparation and worker-runtime composition
ownership.Worker activation/supervision: Kernel InstanceActor/watchdog and generic worker activator
ownership.Artifact contracts: contracts and manifest schemas; artifact bytes are external to Kernel
ownership.Framework: public API, registry and adapters; no first-party product implementation
ownership.Plugins: official package/artifact implementations and plugin protocol consumers
ownership.Product: product policy, bindings, auth/UI, domain semantics and connector policy
